messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] CRITICAL: HelioCorp VPC AppGateway (appgw-helio-prod) websocket errors spike — 502/connection resets — paging on-call

sara (oncall): I'm on it. Pulling logs and metrics now. Hit me with latest runbooks.

mike (eng-runtime): saw the alert — looks like connection churn with lots of simultaneous reconnects. Could be a thundering herd after a deploy on their side.

kevin (infra): Are they on dedicated pool or shared? I see tenant helio mapped to dedicated-gpupool-3 (60% CPU).

emma (cust-succ): FYI HelioCorp support reported "clients see dropped live sessions" at 08:12 UTC. They're on v1.2 of their SDK with sticky-retry enabled.

sara (oncall): Reproducing logs: here's a tail of streaming proxy errors:

```
2028-03-12T08:12:21Z proxy appgw-helio-prod ERR connection_reset tenant=helio conn_id=53421
2028-03-12T08:12:21Z proxy appgw-helio-prod WARN retry_loop tenant=helio retries=8
```

mike (eng-runtime): looks like per-connection retry loop + sticky retry causing reconnect storms. Suggest temporary mitigation: drop sticky retry header at our edge to cause clients to back off, and enable 429 mapping for upstream failures.

kevin (infra): Can we push iptables CLOSE_WAIT sweep to kill zombie sockets for tenant helio? I can run a graceful drain script.

sara (oncall): Also paging SRE for low-level network flaps. @david can you check if our NAT gateway is hitting conntrack limits? :eyes: 

david (network): confirming. conntrack table for gw-node-12 is 98% full. There are many TIME_WAIT entries from helio IP blocks. Likely a burst of short-lived websockets.

emma (cust-succ): HelioCorp wants near-immediate fix. Their retention is at risk. They asked for "temporary redirect to short-polling" if we can't stabilize websockets.

mike (eng-runtime): Plan A: apply per-tenant throttle at edge so we can accept connections but rate-limit new handshakes. Plan B: if conntrack keeps filling, route helio traffic to fallback HTTP-polling endpoint in dedicated pool and serve 200 with "switch_to_polling".

sara (oncall): I'm going to execute mitigation steps now. Steps:
1) enable tenant throttling (rate=50 conn/s) on appgw-helio-prod
2) set 429 mapping in gateway config
3) run conntrack sweep script
4) open a handoff with dedicated pool owners

kevin (infra): ready to run drain. command:

```
ssh infra@gw-node-12 'sudo /usr/local/bin/conntrack-sweep --tenant helio --age 30s'
```

sara (oncall): Running now... output:

```
swept 128 entries for tenant helio, freed 96 sockets
```

mike (eng-runtime): Pushing edge throttle rule now (will cause some client 429s). Rule:

```
route /ws/helio {
  rate_limit: 50/s
  on_exceed: 429
}
```

sara (oncall): throttle pushed. Observing incoming connections drop from ~800/s to ~60/s. Error rate decreasing.

david (network): conntrack usage dropping to 67% after sweep and rate limit. Good.

emma (cust-succ): Let me notify HelioCorp: temporary mitigation applied, asking them to pause deploys and reduce client reconnect aggressiveness.

HelioCorp-CS-rep: Thanks. We'll throttle SDK retries from 10 -> 2 for next 20m. Please keep me posted.

mike (eng-runtime): Next step: schedule traffic migration to helio-dedicated-fallback pool with pre-warmed sockets. Doing a controlled redirect via header rewrite `x-helio-fallback: true`.

kevin (infra): Pre-warming fallback pool nodes: `dedicated-pool scale --name helio-dedicated-fallback --replicas 6` — done. Nodes healthy.

sara (oncall): Initiating gradual redirect (10% -> 25% -> 100%) via canary header. Monitor latency and successful connects.

mike (eng-runtime): Canary at 10% — connects stable for 60s. Pushing to 25%.

sara (oncall): 25% stable. 100% in progress.

sara (oncall): 100% migrated. Connection resets down to baseline. Will keep throttles in place for 30 minutes and then remove.

emma (cust-succ): HelioCorp confirms sessions restored. They want a postmortem and change to our recommendation: add per-tenant conntrack limits and better guidance for SDK retry backoff.

sara (oncall): Postmortem TODOs: capture timeline, add runbook step to detect per-tenant conntrack saturation, expose per-tenant socket metrics in console, and add customer SDK recommendation doc. Assigning owners: mike-postmortem, kevin-networking, emma-customer.

mike (eng-runtime): I'll follow up with a small config change to drop `sticky-retry` header if present to our edge for now.

kevin (infra): I'll add conntrack alert at 75% threshold and an automatic sweep action.

david (network): Also verifying kernel tunables to avoid TIME_WAIT explosion — adding sysctl doc.

sara (oncall): Closing paging. No ongoing customer impact. Leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and timeline insertion.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Duration 18m. Severity: high. Pager disengaged :white_check_mark:
